content.page_summary: Reference list (entries 211-217) from a clinical guideline focused on angioplasty/stenting and invasive strategies after fibrinolysis/thrombolysis in acute myocardial infarction (STEMI). Each entry includes authors, study title, journal, year, pages and DOI.

references.authors: Arbel Y, Ko DT, Yan AT, Cantor WJ, Bagai A, Koh M, et al.
references.title: Long-term follow-up of the trial of routine angioplasty and stenting after fibrinolysis to enhance reperfusion in acute myocardial infarction (TRANSFER-AMI).
references.notes: Long-term follow-up of TRANSFER-AMI trial assessing routine angioplasty/stenting after fibrinolysis.

references.authors: Di Mario C, Dudek D, Piscione F, Mielecki W, Savonitto S, Murena E, et al.
references.title: Immediate angioplasty versus standard therapy with rescue angioplasty after thrombolysis in the Combined Abciximab REteplase Stent Study in Acute Myocardial Infarction (CARESS-in-AMI): an open, prospective, randomised, multicentre trial.
references.notes: CARESS-in-AMI trial comparing immediate angioplasty versus standard/rescue angioplasty after thrombolysis; mentions combined Abciximab and Reteplase stent strategy.

references.authors: Bøhmer E, Hoffmann P, Abdelnoor M, Arnesen H, Halvorsen S, et al.
references.title: Efficacy and safety of immediate angioplasty versus ischemia-guided management after thrombolysis in acute myocardial infarction in areas with very long transfer distances: results of the NORDISTEMI (NORwegian study on DIstrict treatment of ST-elevation myocardial infarction).
references.notes: NORDISTEMI trial evaluating immediate angioplasty vs ischemia-guided management after thrombolysis in remote areas.

references.authors: Scheller B, Hennen B, Hammer B, Walle J, Hofer C, Hilpert V, et al.
references.title: Beneficial effects of immediate stenting after thrombolysis in acute myocardial infarction.
references.notes: Study reporting benefits of immediate stenting following thrombolysis in AMI.

references.authors: Le May MR, Wells GA, Labinaz M, Davies RF, Turek AM, Leddy D, et al.
references.title: Combined angioplasty and pharmacological intervention versus thrombolysis alone in acute myocardial infarction (CAPITAL AMI study).
references.notes: CAPITAL AMI study comparing combined angioplasty + pharmacologic intervention vs thrombolysis alone.

references.authors: Abdel-Qadir H, Yan AT, Tan M, Borgia F, Piscione F, Di Mario C, et al.
references.title: Consistency of benefit from an early invasive strategy after fibrinolysis: a patient-level meta-analysis.
references.notes: Patient-level meta-analysis assessing benefit consistency of early invasive strategy after fibrinolysis.

references.authors: Madan M, Halvorsen S, Di Mario C, Tan M, Westerhout CM, Cantor WJ, et al.
references.title: Relationship between time to invasive assessment and clinical outcomes of patients undergoing an early invasive strategy after fibrinolysis for ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction: a patient-level analysis of the randomized early routine invasive clinical trials.
references.notes: Patient-level analysis linking timing of invasive assessment to clinical outcomes after fibrinolysis for STEMI.
